name: Suma Akemi
source:
Something of a hopeless romantic, Akemi is Kouichi’s history teacher. She has a motherly personality that often leads her into overtly helping (some would say meddling) with her students’ personal lives. Despite her desire to find the perfect love life, Akemi seems destined to fail in that dream: especially with her father around.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064424/http://www.elizar.com/?p=3]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
